content.title: Semantic Wuxia Typography | Action Commitment, Impact Words, Three-Chapter Escalation
content.summary: A bridge inspector turns measurement, fog and route actions into three semantic title chapters. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Each chapter begins with one readable short title. + One physical action drives one matching graphic stroke. + The same palette and line grammar connect all chapters. + Motion scale grows from hand tool to environment route. + The final mark and completed action hold together.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open an original ivory-charcoal graphic field with the exact chapter title HOLD THE LINE and one adult bridge inspector carrying a folded measuring staff. Switch to the exact title THROUGH THE FOG as the same inspector opens a signal lamp and walks through diagonal silver mist. Let the route and mist converge into one large original mark, then hold the inspector at the completed crossing.
required_anchors: Each chapter begins with one readable short title.
One physical action drives one matching graphic stroke.
Motion scale grows from hand tool to environment route.
The final mark and completed action hold together.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A bridge inspector turns measurement, fog and route actions into three semantic title chapters. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
